theorems.name: Submission.rectifiability_bf_cone_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (N m : ℕ) (E : Set (Eucl N)) (v : Fin (m + 1) → Eucl N) (δ : ℝ), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.PurelyUnrectifiable (m + 1) E → 0 < δ → (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl N)) {a | a ∈ E ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ s ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl N)) (E ∩ {x | dist x a < r ∧ ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) (x - a)) : Eucl (m + 1))‖ < s * ‖x - a‖}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (η * (r * s) ^ (m + 1))} = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
